mainEntity.name: What is a white-label digital marketing agency?

acceptedAnswer.text: It is a company that delivers marketing work which another agency sells under its own brand. The agency owns the client and the pricing; the white-label partner does the work behind it, under an NDA.

mainEntity.name: What is digital marketing fulfilment, and how is MMC different from a fulfilment platform?

acceptedAnswer.text: Fulfilment means a partner delivers the work an agency has sold. A platform sells packages from a menu with little contact. MMC gives you a named strategist and specialists, a written scope per client, a pilot client before you scale, and an NDA before we see client details.

mainEntity.name: How does white-label work with MMC?

acceptedAnswer.text: We sign an NDA, agree scope, set up reporting in your format, run a first client together and scale from there. You stay the only point of contact for your client unless you ask otherwise.
We start with one of your clients under a written scope, with check-in points and reporting in your format. You judge us on that work before adding more clients or services.

mainEntity.name: Which services can you white label?

acceptedAnswer.text: SEO, local SEO for US and UK businesses, link building, GEO and AEO, Google Ads and PPC, paid social on Meta and LinkedIn, Shopify and Shopify Plus, WordPress and WooCommerce, custom web development, mobile apps, social media management, creative and design, video and UGC, email and retention, content writing and reporting dashboards. Each has its own page.

mainEntity.name: Do you work with agencies in the US, UK, Canada and Australia?

acceptedAnswer.text: We do, and with agencies in the UAE, Singapore, India and the rest of Europe. UK, Australian, UAE and Singapore agencies get full overlap with our working day; US agencies get overlap in the evening, India time, or a dedicated shift. Exact hours are agreed per team.

mainEntity.name: Will my client know MMC is involved?

acceptedAnswer.text: Only if you choose to tell them. We sign an NDA, work under your brand, send deliverables in your format and do not contact your clients unless you ask us to.
No. We do not approach your clients, and we sign an NDA covering client information. If you want us on a client call, you invite us as part of your team.
Yes. We can supply reports in your format and name, or send numbers for your own template. What the client sees is your decision.

By scope, under one model: a retainer, a project, a dedicated team, an hour block or the reseller programme. We do not publish prices; we agree the model on a call and write the scope down. The minimum commitment is three months.

mainEntity.name: Which currencies do you invoice in?

acceptedAnswer.text: Indian rupees or US dollars. We agree which one when we write the scope.

answer.chip: A delivery team behind your agency

paras: In a white-label arrangement one company does the work and another sells it under its own name. For an agency, that means a partner who can run SEO, ads, web builds or creative for your client while you stay the face of the account.

It is different from referral work, where a partner takes the client, and from hiring freelancers, where you manage every task. A white-label partner owns delivery quality and timelines against a scope you agree, and you own the relationship.
blocks.cap: An agency scoping work with its delivery partner.

blocks.h: Digital marketing fulfilment: a team, not a platform
paras: Agency fulfilment means a partner delivers the work your agency has sold. Some providers run it as a platform: you pick a package from a menu, upload a brief and receive the output, often without knowing who did it. MMC works differently in four ways.
People you can name. A senior strategist scopes your account and stays on it, and you know which specialists do the work. Questions go to a person, not a ticket queue.
A written scope. Before work starts we write down what each client gets, what is out of scope and how changes are handled, so you can quote and invoice against it.
A pilot client first. We start with one of your clients, with check-in points and reporting in your format, so you judge us on real work before adding more accounts.
An NDA before client details. We sign it before we see anything about your clients, and we do not contact them unless you ask us to.

blocks.h: What you keep and what we do
paras: You keep the client relationship, the pricing, the invoice, the strategy conversation and the final say on anything the client sees.
We do the audits, builds, campaigns, content and creative in the scope, the quality checks before work reaches you, and the report in your format, with notes for your client call.
We agree together the scope per client, the deadlines (your client date and an earlier internal one), who approves what, and whether anyone from our side joins a client call as part of your team.

paras: One partner can cover search, paid media, social, content, email and web under a single scope, so your agency can offer full-service packages without hiring a specialist for each channel. A named strategist coordinates the channels, paid and organic are planned together so budgets and targets agree, and you receive one combined report.

Some agencies prefer a specialist per channel. Others want one partner who joins the dots. Both work; the right choice depends on how many clients you serve and how much coordination you want to manage.
If you only need a single channel, start with its own page: white-label SEO, white-label PPC or white-label social media management. You can start with one channel and add more as clients ask.

Pick the model that matches how you sell. A dedicated team suits steady volume, the SEO reseller programme suits repeatable packages bought at a wholesale rate, and the pricing models page explains what drives cost and how to set your margin.
Every model starts with a written scope. We invoice in Indian rupees or US dollars, and the minimum commitment is three months.

blocks.h: Delivery from India for agencies abroad
paras: Our team works from Mumbai and Indore and serves agencies in the US, UK, Canada, Australia, the UAE, Singapore, India and the rest of Europe remotely.

Agencies in the UK, Australia, the UAE and Singapore get full overlap with our working day. US agencies get partial overlap in the evening, India time, or a dedicated shift for a team that needs more. Every region also gets written updates at fixed times each day. Exact hours are agreed per team and written into the scope.
See how contracts, data and invoicing work on the page about our white-label agency in India.
Digital agencies use it to add disciplines their clients ask for without hiring a specialist for each.
Web studios use it to add SEO, ads or maintenance after a build, so the client relationship continues past launch.
Creative studios use it to offer performance work alongside the creative they already make.

stages.why: Client goals, access and brand rules sit in your inbox and your head, so the first draft guesses.
stages.does: We send one intake form, hold a short handover call and write back what we understood before any work starts.

stages.breaks: Work lands the night before the client call.
stages.why: The date you promised the client never reached the person doing the work.
stages.does: Each deliverable gets your client date and an earlier internal one, tracked on a shared board you can open.

stages.breaks: Quality drifts when you are not looking.
stages.why: Different people, different weeks, and the client notices before you do.
stages.does: Every piece passes a checklist and a second reviewer before it reaches you, so you approve instead of repair.

stages.breaks: Reports show activity, not what it means.
stages.why: A wall of metrics gives you nothing to say on the call.
stages.does: We add a short note to each report: what moved, why, and what happens next, in your template and voice.

stages.why: Scope creep, rework and unplanned calls turn a good retainer into a loss.
stages.does: Scope is written per client, extras are quoted back to you first, and your costs from us stay easy to predict.
